changelog:
- Initial release of the academic-researcher skill.
- Provides structured assistance for literature reviews, paper analysis, and scholarly writing.
- Includes detailed analysis frameworks and citation formatting guides (APA, MLA, Chicago).
- Offers templates for literature review structure and academic paper summaries.
- Emphasizes academic writing standards and best practices.
- Example summary included for spaced repetition research.
summary: Academic research assistant for literature reviews, paper analysis, and scholarly writing. Use when: reviewing academic papers, conducting literature reviews...
